record.bible_text: Thou shalt not raise<WH05375><WTH8799> a false<WH07723> report<WH08088>: put<WH07896><WTH8799> not thine hand<WH03027> with the wicked<WH07563> to be an unrighteous<WH02555> witness<WH05707>. <RF>raise: or, receive<Rf>

Neither shalt thou countenance<WH01921><WTH8799> a poor<WH01800> man in his cause<WH07379>.

Thou shalt not wrest<WH05186><WTH8686> the judgment<WH04941> of thy poor<WH034> in his cause<WH07379>.

Keep thee far<WH07368><WTH8799> from a false<WH08267> matter<WH01697>; and the innocent<WH05355> and righteous<WH06662> slay<WH02026><WTH8799> thou not: for I will not justify<WH06663><WTH8686> the wicked<WH07563>.

Also thou shalt not oppress<WH03905><WTH8799> a stranger<WH01616>: for ye know<WH03045><WTH8804> the heart<WH05315> of a stranger<WH01616>, seeing<WH03588> ye were strangers<WH01616> in the land<WH0776> of Egypt<WH04714>. <RF>heart: Heb. soul<Rf><CM>
And six<WH08337> years<WH08141> thou shalt sow<WH02232><WTH8799> thy land<WH0776>, and shalt gather<WH0622><WTH8804> in the fruits<WH08393> thereof:

But the seventh<WH07637> <FI>year<Fi> thou shalt let it rest<WH08058><WTH8799> and lie<WH05203><WTH8804> still; that the poor<WH034> of thy people<WH05971> may eat<WH0398><WTH8804>: and what they leave<WH03499> the beasts<WH02416> of the field<WH07704> shall eat<WH0398><WTH8799>. Six<WH08337> days<WH03117> thou shalt do<WH06213><WTH8799> thy work<WH04639>, and on the seventh<WH07637> day<WH03117> thou shalt rest<WH07673><WTH8799>: that thine ox<WH07794> and thine ass<WH02543> may rest<WH05117><WTH8799>, and the son<WH01121> of thy handmaid<WH0519>, and the stranger<WH01616>, may be refreshed<WH05314><WTH8735>.

And in all <FI>things<Fi> that I have said<WH0559><WTH8804> unto you be circumspect<WH08104><WTH8735>: and make no mention<WH02142><WTH8686> of the name<WH08034> of other<WH0312> gods<WH0430>, neither let it be heard<WH08085><WTH8735> out<WH05921> of thy mouth<WH06310>.
Three<WH07969> times<WH07272> thou shalt keep a feast<WH02287><WTH8799> unto me in the year<WH08141>.

Thou shalt keep<WH08104><WTH8799> the feast<WH02282> of unleavened bread<WH04682>: (thou shalt eat<WH0398><WTH8799> unleavened bread<WH04682> seven<WH07651> days<WH03117>, as I commanded<WH06680><WTH8765> thee, in the time appointed<WH04150> of the month<WH02320> Abib<WH024>; for in it thou camest out<WH03318><WTH8804> from Egypt<WH04714>: and none shall appear<WH07200><WTH8735> before<WH06440> me empty<WH07387>:)

Three<WH07969> times<WH06471> in the year<WH08141> all thy males<WH02138> shall appear<WH07200><WTH8735> before<WH06440> the Lord<WH0113> GOD<WH03068>.

Thou shalt not offer<WH02076><WTH8799> the blood<WH01818> of my sacrifice<WH02077> with leavened bread<WH02557>; neither shall the fat<WH02459> of my sacrifice<WH02282> remain<WH03885><WTH8799> until the morning<WH01242>. <RF>sacrifice: or, feast<Rf>

The first<WH07225> of the firstfruits<WH01061> of thy land<WH0127> thou shalt bring<WH0935><WTH8686> into the house<WH01004> of the LORD<WH03068> thy God<WH0430>. Thou shalt not seethe<WH01310><WTH8762> a kid<WH01423> in his mother's<WH0517> milk<WH02461>.<CM>

Behold, I send<WH07971><WTH8802> an Angel<WH04397> before<WH06440> thee, to keep<WH08104><WTH8800> thee in the way<WH01870>, and to bring<WH0935><WTH8687> thee into the place<WH04725> which I have prepared<WH03559><WTH8689>.

Beware<WH08104><WTH8734> of<WH06440> him, and obey<WH08085><WTH8798> his voice<WH06963>, provoke<WH04843><WTH8686> him not; for he will not pardon<WH05375><WTH8799> your transgressions<WH06588>: for my name<WH08034> <FI>is<Fi> in him<WH07130>.

But if thou shalt indeed<WH08085><WTH8800> obey<WH08085><WTH8799> his voice<WH06963>, and do<WH06213><WTH8804> all that I speak<WH01696><WTH8762>; then I will be an enemy<WH0340><WTH8804> unto thine enemies<WH0341><WTH8802>, and an adversary<WH06887><WTH8802> unto thine adversaries<WH06696><WTH8804>. <RF>an adversary...: or, I will afflict them that afflict thee<Rf>

For mine Angel<WH04397> shall go<WH03212><WTH8799> before<WH06440> thee, and bring<WH0935><WTH8689> thee in unto the Amorites<WH0567>, and the Hittites<WH02850>, and the Perizzites<WH06522>, and the Canaanites<WH03669>, the Hivites<WH02340>, and the Jebusites<WH02983>: and I will cut them off<WH03582><WTH8689>.

Thou shalt not bow down<WH07812><WTH8691> to their gods<WH0430>, nor serve<WH05647><WTH8714> them, nor do<WH06213><WTH8799> after their works<WH04639>: but thou shalt utterly<WH02040><WTH8763> overthrow<WH02040><WTH8762> them, and quite<WH07665><WTH8763> break down<WH07665><WTH8762> their images<WH04676>.

And ye shall serve<WH05647><WTH8804> the LORD<WH03068> your God<WH0430>, and he shall bless<WH01288><WTH8765> thy bread<WH03899>, and thy water<WH04325>; and I will take<WH05493><WH00> sickness<WH04245> away<WH05493><WTH8689> from the midst<WH07130> of thee.
There shall nothing cast their young<WH07921><WTH8764>, nor be barren<WH06135>, in thy land<WH0776>: the number<WH04557> of thy days<WH03117> I will fulfil<WH04390><WTH8762>.

I will send<WH07971><WTH8762> my fear<WH0367> before<WH06440> thee, and will destroy<WH02000><WTH8804> all the people<WH05971> to whom thou shalt come<WH0935><WTH8799>, and I will make<WH05414><WTH8804> all thine enemies<WH0341><WTH8802> turn their backs<WH06203> unto thee. <RF>backs: Heb. neck<Rf>

And I will send<WH07971><WTH8804> hornets<WH06880> before<WH06440> thee, which shall drive out<WH01644><WTH8765> the Hivite<WH02340>, the Canaanite<WH03669>, and the Hittite<WH02850>, from before<WH06440> thee.

I will not drive them out<WH01644><WTH8762> from before<WH06440> thee in one<WH0259> year<WH08141>; lest the land<WH0776> become desolate<WH08077>, and the beast<WH02416> of the field<WH07704> multiply<WH07227> against thee.
By little<WH04592> and little<WH04592> I will drive them out<WH01644><WTH8762> from before<WH06440> thee, until thou be increased<WH06509><WTH8799>, and inherit<WH05157><WTH8804> the land<WH0776>.

And I will set<WH07896><WTH8804> thy bounds<WH01366> from the Red<WH05488> sea<WH03220> even unto the sea<WH03220> of the Philistines<WH06430>, and from the desert<WH04057> unto the river<WH05104>: for I will deliver<WH05414><WTH8799> the inhabitants<WH03427><WTH8802> of the land<WH0776> into your hand<WH03027>; and thou shalt drive them out<WH01644><WTH8765> before<WH06440> thee.
Thou shalt make<WH03772><WTH8799> no covenant<WH01285> with them, nor with their gods<WH0430>.
